observation.command: ADMIN_TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:8080/realms/master/protocol/openid-connect/token" -d "grant_type=password&client_id=admin-cli&username=admin&password=admin" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['access_token'])") && UUID="fe46cc38-b90a-4bd4-ae89-c3075c2dc455" && echo "=== Client roles ===" && curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients/$UUID/roles" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print([r['name'] for r in json.load(sys.stdin)])" && echo "=== user1 client role mappings ===" && UID2=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/users?username=user1" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]['id'])") && curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/users/$UID2/role-mappings/clients/$UUID" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print([r['name'] for r in json.load(sys.stdin)])"
